description: You're an electrical apprentice reconstructing your work hour log for state licensing. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/apprentice_hours_draft.xlsx. Complete 3 missing data entries: (1) Row 5 work type should be 'Commercial', (2) Row 9 supervision should be 'Independent', (3) Row 13 hours should be 9.5. Create formulas: B18 for total supervised hours (SUMIF), B19 for total independent hours (SUMIF), B20 for grand total, B21 for hours remaining to 8000, B22 for progress percentage. Add work type breakdowns in E18-E21 using SUMIF. Apply conditional formatting: red background on B19 if >1600, green on B22 if ≥50% (else yellow/orange). Add title row 'Electrical Apprenticeship Hour Log - [Year]' merged across A-E with bold 14pt formatting, and include apprentice ID 'EA-2847-TX'. Save with Ctrl+S.
